literal_meaning: যেন ঝুলে পড়া বা দোলানোর শব্দানুকরণ (onomatopoeic expression of swaying or dangling)
figurative_meaning_en: Expression of dancing or prancing about without any reason
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খুশিতে ঢ্যাংঢ্যাং করে নাচতে লাগল।
example_sentences_in_english: He started dancing around dhyang-dhyang out of sheer joy.
The children are prancing about in the yard for no reason.
note: This idiom captures the lively, spontaneous movements often seen in rural Bengali festivities or daily play.
